from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class PaperCitationRecord(BaseModel):
    """A record of one paper extracted from a document, containing its title and which other provided papers it references."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of this paper as written in the document text")
    references_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of the OTHER provided papers that appear in this paper's reference list")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[PaperCitationRecord]
